title: Zainab ka Tha Ye Noha
body:
zainab ka tha ye nauha bhai hai bhuka pyasa
ay shimr tu teher ja bhai hai bhuka pyasa
<<DIVIDER>>
sookhe gale pe khanjar mat phayr ay sitamgar
pani pilade thoda bhai hai bhuka pyasa
ay shimr tu teher ja…
zainab ka tha ye nauha…
<<DIVIDER>>
seene se tu utar ja zaqmon may dard hoga
mazloom par taraz kha bhai hai bhuka pyasa
ay shimr tu teher ja…
zainab ka tha ye nauha…
<<DIVIDER>>
khoya hai naujawan ko gaada hai bezaban ko
koi nahi hai us ka bhai hai bhuka pyasa
ay shimr tu teher ja…
zainab ka tha ye nauha…
<<DIVIDER>>
chadar ko cheenle tu qaimon ko loot le tu
us ki nahi hai parwa bhai hai bhuka pyasa
ay shimr tu teher ja…
zainab ka tha ye nauha…
<<DIVIDER>>
arz o samaa ke waali dena hai tu gawahi
pehlu may beh ke darya bhai hai bhuka pyasa
ay shimr tu teher ja…
zainab ka tha ye nauha…
<<DIVIDER>>
ya fatema ab aao ya murtaza ab aao
dam todta hai beta bhai hai bhuka pyasa
ay shimr tu teher ja…
zainab ka tha ye nauha…
